298 (``stream`` if given, otherwise ``default_stream()``). Recording a 

299 default-stream token requires a CUDA context to be current. Host-only

301 and need no context.

341 @staticmethod 

342 def _reduce_helper(mr, ipc_descriptor): 

343 cdef ContextHandle h_ctx = get_current_context() 

344 cdef int device_id 

345 if not h_ctx: 

346 # Spawned processes unpickle arguments before entering their target, 

347 # so initialize the context needed to bind the default-stream token. 

348 device_id = mr.device_id 

349 (Device(device_id) if device_id >= 0 else Device()).set_current() 

350 # The parent process's stream is not portable across processes, so the 

351 # pickle path cannot thread an explicit stream through. Seed the 

352 # imported buffer's deallocation with the current context's default 

353 # stream; the receiver can override it before or during close. 

354 return Buffer.from_ipc_descriptor(mr, ipc_descriptor, stream=default_stream())

792cdef class MemoryResource: 

793 """Abstract base class for memory resources that manage allocation and 

794 deallocation of buffers. 

795  

796 Subclasses must implement methods for allocating and deallocation, as well 

797 as properties associated with this memory resource from which all allocated 

798 buffers will inherit. (Since all :class:`Buffer` instances allocated and 

799 returned by the :meth:`allocate` method would hold a reference to self, the 

800 buffer properties are retrieved simply by looking up the underlying memory 

801 resource's respective property.) 

802 """ 

803  

804 def allocate(self, size_t size, *, stream: Stream | GraphBuilder) -> Buffer: 

805 """Allocate a buffer of the requested size. 

806  

807 Parameters 

808 ---------- 

809 size : int 

810 The size of the buffer to allocate, in bytes. 

811 stream : :obj:`~_stream.Stream` | :obj:`~graph.GraphBuilder` 

812 Keyword-only. The stream on which to perform the allocation 

813 asynchronously. Must be passed explicitly; pass 

814 ``device.default_stream`` to use the default stream. For subclasses 

815 that support stream-ordered deallocation, this stream also orders 

816 the buffer's eventual deallocation, so if the buffer may be freed 

817 from a different host thread, prefer a stream other than the 

818 per-thread default stream, which refers to a different stream on 

819 each thread. 

820  

821 Returns 

822 ------- 

823 Buffer 

824 The allocated buffer object, which can be used for device or host operations 

825 depending on the resource's properties. 

826 """
